import subprocess, random, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp/t')
from stress_native import random_layout, h
import image as img
E='/workspace/tmp/eng_ubsan'
rng=random.Random(777)
errs=0
for it in range(40):
    R=rng.randrange(1,65)
    starts=[0]+sorted({rng.randrange(1,1<<rng.choice([20,60,128])) for _ in range(R-1)}) if R>1 else [0]
    while len(starts)<R: starts.append(starts[-1]+rng.randrange(1,1<<20))
    starts=starts[:R]; R=len(starts)
    hops=[rng.choice([None,rng.randrange(0,2**31-1)]) for _ in range(R)]
    layout=random_layout(R,starts,rng)
    A=rng.randrange(0,50)
    addrs=[rng.randrange(0,1<<128) for _ in range(A)]
    lines=['PACK %d %d %d'%(R,len(layout),A)]
    lines+=['%s %d'%(h(starts[i]), -1 if hops[i] is None else hops[i]) for i in range(R)]
    for kind,mode,cached,lo,span,kids in layout:
        lines.append('%d %d %d %d %d %s'%(lo,span,mode,cached,len(kids),' '.join(map(str,kids))))
    lines+=[h(a) for a in addrs]
    p=subprocess.run([E],input=('\n'.join(lines)+'\n').encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    if p.returncode or p.stderr: errs+=1; print('UBSAN', p.returncode, p.stderr.decode()[:300]); break
    pyimg=img.build(R,starts,hops,layout)
    if p.stdout.decode().split('\n')[0]!=pyimg.hex: errs+=1; print('image mismatch'); break
    toks=[x for x in p.stdout.decode().split('\n') if x.strip()]
    # TRACE the same image
    p2=subprocess.run([E],input=('TRACE %d\n%s\n'%(A,pyimg.hex)+'\n'.join(h(a) for a in addrs)+'\n').encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    if p2.returncode or p2.stderr: errs+=1; print('UBSAN trace', p2.stderr.decode()[:300]); break
    t2=[x for x in p2.stdout.decode().split('\n') if x.strip()]
    if t2!=toks[1:1+A]: errs+=1; print('trace/pack mismatch'); break
# atlas under ubsan
for it in range(10):
    n=rng.choice([0,1,50,5000])
    lines=['ATLAS %d'%n]
    for i in range(n):
        L=rng.choice([0,1,32,64,127,128])
        s=rng.randrange(0,1<<128); s=(s>>(128-L))<<(128-L) if L else 0
        lines.append('%s %d %d'%(h(s),L,rng.randrange(0,2**31-1)))
    p=subprocess.run([E],input=('\n'.join(lines)+'\n').encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    if p.returncode or p.stderr: errs+=1; print('UBSAN atlas',p.stderr.decode()[:300]); break
print('ubsan clean, errs=',errs)
PYEOF
